summary: A person's own layer may say which columns are pinned, beside their order and width.

then.note: Pinning was a shared-only field before 1.4.0, so a host on an earlier version may refuse this write: that is why the version moved instead of the field changing meaning in place. The mechanism case beside this one still holds — a host that does declare a shared-only field refuses it in a personal write — and 1.4.0 declares none.
